threads.body: `get_content_attributes` is now annotated as returning `dict[str, AttributeValue]`, but when `for_span` is False it returns structured values (lists/dicts) for log event attributes (see `serialize(...): return ... else dicts`). This makes the type signature incorrect and also reintroduces `Any` via the `serialize` helper. Consider either (a) using overloads keyed on `Literal[True/False]` and a dedicated structured-value type for the event case, or (b) keeping this function typed as `dict[str, Any]` until log/event attribute types are fully audited (per #41 scope note).
